name: Pixel-Weighted Line Integration
aliases: Sinogram generation via pixel-weighted line integration
definition: A forward projection technique that computes a sinogram by approximating line integrals over a 2D image using pixel weights, iterating over a set of angles and parallel rays.
summary: Pixel-Weighted Line Integration computes sinograms via Bresenham-like rasterization, avoiding large matrix inversion by manually calculating pixel weights for line integrals.
